title: poker: implement fold/check/call/raise/all_in actions
description: fold, check, call, raise, all_in are declared in ActionTypeLiteral (action.py) but transition.py apply_action() hits the else-raise for all of them. Need implementations: fold marks player inactive and emits fold event; check is a no-op pass in a betting round; call deducts chips equal to (current_bet - player_contribution) and adds to pot; raise sets new current_bet and deducts chips; all_in puts player's remaining chips into pot and marks them all-in. Tests: TestTier2BettingActionsGap in tests/test_poker.py.
